interaction_limitation: Native has direct answer image access; F/P/B/C do not. C-P and C-B conditional contributions, not pure four-cell factorial with Native.
multiplicity: Bonferroni within each dataset six comparisons; exploratory -1pp one-sided lower CI, no confirmatory claim
smoke_assertions: All36 MLP/norm and residual; native mRoPE and 3 deepstack; zero blocked attention; early skip affects P-1 only; actual compact KV and hidden rows; cleanup normal/exception; no fallback

smoke_tolerance.action: Any failure stops both workers before pilot/main/performance; do not relax

timing: Each image, each condition: three warmups + five repeats, interleaved; coldKV; original pixels; file IO/processor excluded; CUDA events and synchronized wall E2E
vqav2_scoring: Pinned ate_fulljoint_vqav2.common.score: official punctuation/digit/article helpers on both pred and gold, then ten-answer leave-one-out consensus
